name: herb-lsp
description: VS Code extension for connecting with the Herb Language Server and Language Tools for HTML+ERB files

languageServerHerb.linter.enabled.description: Enable/disable the Herb Linter. The linter provides comprehensive HTML+ERB validation, enforces best practices, and catches common errors with a set of configurable rules, like proper tag nesting, required attributes, and ERB usage patterns.
languageServerHerb.linter.enabled.markdownDescription:
Enable/disable the [Herb Linter](https://herb-tools.dev/projects/linter). The linter provides comprehensive HTML+ERB validation, enforces best practices, and catches common errors with a set of configurable [rules](https://herb-tools.dev/linter/rules/), like proper tag nesting, required attributes, and ERB usage patterns.

**Note**: This is a personal default. If a `.herb.yml` file exists in your project, its configuration takes precedence.

languageServerHerb.linter.fixOnSave.description: Automatically autofix correctable linter offenses when saving files.
languageServerHerb.linter.fixOnSave.markdownDescription: Automatically autofix correctable linter offenses when saving files.

languageServerHerb.formatter.enabled.description: Enable/disable document formatting using the Herb Formatter (Experimental Preview). WARNING: This formatter is experimental and may potentially corrupt files. Only use on files that can be restored via git or other version control.
languageServerHerb.formatter.enabled.markdownDescription:
Enable/disable document formatting using the [Herb Formatter](https://herb-tools.dev/projects/formatter) **(Experimental Preview)**. ⚠️ **WARNING**: This formatter is experimental and may potentially corrupt files. Only use on files that can be restored via git or other version control.

**Note**: This is a personal default. If a `.herb.yml` file exists in your project, its configuration takes precedence.

languageServerHerb.formatter.indentWidth.description: Number of spaces for each indentation level.
languageServerHerb.formatter.indentWidth.markdownDescription:
Number of spaces for each indentation level.

**Note**: This is a personal default. If a `.herb.yml` file exists in your project, its configuration takes precedence.

languageServerHerb.formatter.indentStyle.markdownDescription:
Character used for indentation.

**Note**: This is a personal default. If a `.herb.yml` file exists in your project, its configuration takes precedence.

languageServerHerb.formatter.maxLineLeng.markdownDescription:
Maximum line length before wrapping.

**Note**: This is a personal default. If a `.herb.yml` file exists in your project, its configuration takes precedence.

languageServerHerb.inlayHints.enabled.description: Annotate the closing tag of longer blocks with what it closes. An ERB end tag shows the expression that opened the block, and an HTML closing tag shows the element's id or class.
languageServerHerb.inlayHints.enabled.markdownDescription:
Annotate the closing tag of longer blocks with what it closes. An ERB `<% end %>` shows the expression that opened the block, like `# if user.admin?`, and an HTML closing tag shows the element's `id` or `class`, like `<!-- .card.card-wide -->`.

**Note**: VS Code's own `editor.inlayHints.enabled` still applies on top of this, and turning it off hides hints from every extension.

languageServerHerb.inlayHints.minimumLin.description: How many lines below its opening tag a closing tag has to be before it gets a hint. The default of 2 leaves blocks that fit within two lines unannotated.
languageServerHerb.inlayHints.minimumLin.markdownDescription: How many lines below its opening tag a closing tag has to be before it gets a hint. The default of `2` leaves blocks that fit within two lines unannotated, since you can still see what they opened.

languageServerHerb.inlayHints.maximumCla.description: How many of an element's classes to include in its hint. Past a couple the list is the element's styling rather than its name, so the rest are left off. Set to 0 to name elements by id alone.
languageServerHerb.inlayHints.maximumCla.markdownDescription: How many of an element's classes to include in its hint. Past a couple the list is the element's styling rather than its name, so the rest are left off, which keeps utility-class markup readable. Set to `0` to name elements by `id` alone.

languageServerHerb.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between Visual Studio Code and the Herb language server (for debugging).

languageServerHerb.workspace.suggestAddi.description: Suggest adding a file's project folder to the workspace when an HTML+ERB file outside the current workspace folders is opened. Herb only analyzes files inside workspace folders.
languageServerHerb.workspace.suggestAddi.markdownDescription: Suggest adding a file's project folder to the workspace when an HTML+ERB file outside the current workspace folders is opened. Herb only analyzes files inside workspace folders.

Create a Herb configuration file to share Herb settings with your team.

scripts.build: yarn clean && yarn sync-defaults && yarn run typecheck && yarn build:language-server && node esbuild.js
scripts.pretest: yarn run build-tests && yarn run build
scripts.test: if [ -z "$DISPLAY" ]; then xvfb-run -a yarn vscode:test; else yarn vscode:test; fi
scripts.prepublishOnly: yarn clean && yarn build && yarn test
